bullets.text: Major Russian grain export terminals were reportedly hit in a Ukrainian Black Sea port attack, impacting grain exports from both countries as they target each other's shipping facilities.
At least 44 people have died after an overcrowded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, with rescue operations underway for dozens still missing.
The virus causing a massive Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be mutating, as cases have exceeded 4,000, prompting an escalated response to find patients.
The Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman has recommended a comprehensive review of telco services in regional Australia, citing systemic issues and suggesting a return to 1960s service standards.
There is mounting pressure on Prime Minister Albanese to deliver on gambling reform after allegations surfaced that some betting companies offered gamblers drugs and sex workers as incentives.
ASIO has been urged to investigate after 147 unidentified drones were reportedly flown over Australian air bases, raising security concerns.
US inflation dropped to 3.4% in July, easing concerns about imminent interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve and contributing to a rally in gold and stocks.
China is increasingly influential in global oil markets, with The Economist suggesting its Communist Party now holds significant sway, overshadowing OPEC.
A top Federal Reserve official noted that poorer Americans are struggling financially and indicated she would support an interest rate increase in September if inflation remains high.
